name: vidIQ
description: vidIQ lets agents read YouTube channel and video statistics, keyword data, and trends. Access is read-only, and each user signs in to their own vidIQ account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which of my videos got the most views in the last 90 days?
Find keyword ideas for a video about home espresso with their competition.
Compare my channel's growth with two similar channels.

apps.name: vidIQ
apps.description: YouTube channel analytics and keyword research, over vidIQ's MCP server with browser sign-in.
